alias_signal_findings.behavioral_limit: The fixture uses a single local ZkTestServer. It verifies the client/provider read behavior and exact failure observation, not multi-node ZooKeeper ensemble or follower-lag behavior.
alias_signal_findings.client_session_scope: This observes calls made through one SolrZkClient instance only. It is not a process-wide, session-wide, or cluster-wide signal and does not capture other clients or raw ZooKeeper access that bypasses this instance.
alias_signal_findings.false_positive_scope: The recorder is instance-scoped and the assertion is exact-path scoped, so unrelated clients and unrelated ZK paths cannot trigger it. A different operation on the same client that reads the same alias state path during the observation window could still be recorded; the test clears attempts immediately before the provider call and uses a unique test alias to limit that risk.
alias_signal_findings.maintenance_cost: Low and test-local: a small SolrZkClient subclass, a ReadAttempt record, a thread-safe CopyOnWriteArrayList, one ZkTestServer fixture, and an explicit positive control. No production metric or logging changes are introduced.
alias_signal_findings.mutation_evidence: The new observer reports NoNodeException at /collections/target_testKnownAliasDoesNotReadAliasCollectionState_alias/state.json when the guard is removed; the same test's positive control records the same exact logical path and failure type.
alias_signal_findings.old_metric_limitation: Under a mutation that removes only the known-alias guard, the original global-metrics test passes 1/1 while the new path-specific test fails. The global metric can be affected by unrelated client reads and therefore is not sufficient evidence that this exact alias-state path was not read.
alias_signal_findings.stability: The signal observes the SolrZkClient getData API directly and does not parse ZooKeeper debug-log text or depend on log formatting. It is stable for the current call path, but the test should be updated if the provider moves to another getData overload or bypasses SolrZkClient.

implementation.description: The new ZkClientClusterStateProviderTest uses a RecordingSolrZkClient that overrides getData(String, Watcher, Stat), records path plus success/failure, and attaches to the single SolrZkClient instance used by the reader/provider. A direct missing-path positive control observes NoNodeException for the exact alias collection-state path; after clearing records, probing a known alias must not read that path. The HTTP integration test still resolves the alias and repeats queries, but no longer relies on a JVM-wide metric delta.

summary: Added and gated a test-only, path- and client-specific regression for the known-alias failed-read bug. The old global-metrics assertion was reproduced as a false negative under guard removal. The requested sync diagnostic was reviewed: its four behavioral checks pass on one local ZkTestServer, but do not establish ensemble-lag behavior; promotion to durable tests is a separate follow-up.

sync_coverage_assessment.disposable_probe: The archived disposable SyncSplitDiagnosticProbeTest passed 4/4 at seed 18606CAFE. It tested: (1) a withheld Curator sync callback keeps sync blocked past 200 ms and a CONNECTIONLOSS callback maps to KeeperException.ConnectionLossException; (2) interrupting a callback-waiting thread returns InterruptedException promptly (within 10 s, with a longer client timeout); (3) forceUpdateCollection calls sync(COLLECTIONS_ZKNODE) before reading the collection state, verified with Mockito InOrder against one live ZkTestServer; and (4) while sync is blocked, another thread acquires getUpdateLock within 5 s, and a CONNECTIONLOSS callback surfaces before any state read.
sync_coverage_assessment.durable_test_recommendation: For a minimal maintained follow-up, add callback-controlled tests beside SolrZkClientTest for waiting, callback error mapping and interruption, plus a focused ZkStateReader/forceUpdateCollection test for sync-before-state-read ordering and not holding getUpdateLock across the wait. Use latches/controlled callbacks to avoid timing-only assertions where possible. Keep the alias regression patch separate.
sync_coverage_assessment.ensemble_limit: The diagnostic probe and existing smoke test use one local ZkTestServer; they do not prove follower lag, multi-node ensemble behavior, or that sync repairs a stale follower view. A multi-server ensemble test is needed only if those distributed semantics are the target. No such claim is made here.
sync_coverage_assessment.existing_tests: The prior exact-head gate reports SolrZkClientTest 8/8 (including testSync), ZkStateReaderTest 16/16, and TestInPlaceUpdatesDistrib 1/1, with zero failures/errors/skips. The existing branch testSync is a single-server smoke test.
